summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with int coordinates in the unpadded frame; set_rnd skips dunder attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float; __all__ updated; math replaced by numpy ceil), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Not verified: tests were not run, so the pinned values in test_loading_array are unconfirmed; both test images were set to arange(16) as an inference from the pinned values. setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(1234), which the spec's wording appears to require. Lines 233-235 of utils.py exceed 120 characters in the pre-existing get_valid_patch_size docstring and were left unchanged.
